findings.reason: the endpoint must say the head-keyed withdrawal replaces the record-time ordering for an attempt that has not launched while a launched review still finishes and is carried, otherwise the node removes a documented protection and its own gate cannot show the loss.
findings.text: §34's deliverable says "A review whose head is the head a resume replaced is withdrawn, whether its dispatch record was written before or after the resume", but `withdraw_superseded_review` deliberately refuses to withdraw a review whose worker has launched (`_review_worker_launched` at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1419, :1452), because a running review's verdict reaches the new head through the carry-forward rule; a node implementing the section as written would discard a running review's pointer and defeat that rule, and §34's done-when tests only a never-launched review so nothing in its gate would catch it

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited modules, symbols and revisions resolve at this tree: `promotion_scope.py` holds the landing's `git add` and its staged-reversal read, `withdraw_superseded_review` is at `reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1384`, `repair_manifest_status` at `reckon/crew/runs.py:2179` with `complete` in its repairable vocabulary at `:2129`, and the commits §33 cites (379ed481fd, 79ff6bdadf, 91362fd9fc, 0e339294e5) and §34's base (51752fcbff) all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §34's done-when has no case for a review whose worker already launched, so the withdrawal it asks for is measured only on the case that is already correct.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every done-when writes its logs under the run directory and drives a temporary repository and temporary crew home, both durable and openable by a later reader.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or changelog prose reach the new sections or the symbols they name.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §34 states withdrawal by head unconditionally, which contradicts the existing rule that a launched review finishes and carries its verdict forward, and the section neither preserves nor replaces that rule.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §33, §34 and §35 each name one endpoint, with the reproduction log carried as evidence for it rather than as a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §34 and §35 consume §30's investigation, which is declared done, and no depends-on entry points at a wrong or missing node.
